m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I don't get it. It should be right here! I'm going to be in so much trouble. Oh, hello! You're... you! I could really use your help, Scion.
I wish I could've had the pleasure of teaching you, but a wizard like you didn't exactly have time to take a History of Magic class, did you? Hehe.
I tell you, kids today aren't like you were. I suspect some of my students stole the Alchemy volume of the Encyclopedia Banned Magica set.
Wait, what? You have the Book? WHEW! I'd lose my job if something bad had happened. What's that you say? Trash Monsters in the Dump? Oh dear.
We better take care of this before word gets to Headmaster Ambrose! Let me jot down an incantation and meet you in the Dump.
Isn't this place fantastic? Dumps are a literal treasure trove of cultural information for History buffs like me.
But there'll be plenty of time for me to dig around here later. Let's clean up this Goo before more of those Trash Monsters pop up.
There's a trickle of the enchanted goo coming out of that pipe over there. Whoever is responsible for this could still be on the other end!
You's gonna have to climb up the pipe and confront the source of the Goo. Then we can figure out what to do with the remaining Trash Monsters.
Whoever is behind the Magical Goo what brought the Trash Monsters to life is at the other end of that pipe. Go stop 'em!
